buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: i.Bidder should have supplied stationery items of minimum R s.15 Lakhs as single order at least once in any of the last 3 fi nancial years (i.e., FY 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 ) to any of the State Government / Central Government / Pub lic sector Undertaking Organizations or Institutions. The cop y of Purchase order along with proof of supply completion lik e CRAC, Completion certificate, payment advice etc. shall be attached along with the bid for technical evaluations of the b id. ii. Exempted category bidders (like MSEs, Startups etc.) may submit relevant documents along with the bid for clai ming relaxation with respect to experience criteria specified at clause (i) above. 2) The seller shall submit Original invoice clearly marked for ‘Bill to’ and ‘Shipped to’, Annexure-F (copy en closed in ATC document), Seller’s Bank details, E-invoice if applicable to seller based on his turnover, Test certificate (if applicable) etc to the Paying Authority directly, immediately after dispatching material to the Consignee. As payment is to be released in a time bound manner, non-receipt of these document in time may lead to rejection of supplier. 3) Documents not submitted along with the bid and clarifications sought during evaluation stage, but subs equently being submitted during representation shall not be considered for evaluation. 4) DOCUMENT SUBMISSION : Bidder/s are requested to submit the following documents (except price schedule) duly signed by the authorized signatory o f the bidder with company’s seal with the bid. (a) Take print of the Technical Specification/s (at Specification Document and Buyer Uploaded ATC Do cument) and upload the technical compliance. (b) Data Sheet / Details of offered product with declaration that the offered product / make / model is meeting the technical specification mentioned in bid document. (c) Documents pertaining to qualification criteria, if any as per bid conditions. Bid submitted without these documents may be liable for rejection. 5) GeM GTC stipulates the one bid per bidder condition under clause no. 29. To ensure compliance to this c lause, a declaration as per format Annexure-II enclosed in ATC, may be submitted along with bid. 6 ) Benefits to MSEs under Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012:

Only manufacturers quoting for goods/ product manufactured by them shall be eligible for av ailing benefits under the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012. Dealers / Distributors / Sole Agents/ Resellers/ Traders/ Stockiest will not be considered for benefits under the subjec t policy and are required to pay requisite EMD as stipulated in the bid document. Seller declara tion statin g that the offered product is manufactured by them shall be submitted along with bi d. (THE ATTACHED DOCUMENT SHALL BE UPLOADED BY THE SELLER ALONG WITH THEIR OFFERED B ID, DULY SIGNED AND STAMPED, IN CONFIRMATION OF HAVING ACCEPTED / COMPLIED WITH BUY ER’S TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS. BIDS SUBMITTED WITHOUT THIS DOCUMENT SHALL NOT BE CO NSIDERED FOR EVALUATION AND LIABLE FOR REJECTION) 7. ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS: Department of Expenditure vide OM No.F.1/1/2022-PPD Dated.02/02/2022 has notified amendme nt to the rule / para 170 (i) of the GFR 2017 regarding Bid Security and Performance Guarantee. A ccording to the amendment, Insurance Surety Bonds are also acceptable form of security in additi on to the existing acceptable security in the form of Bank Guarantee from a commercial bank / acc ount payee DD / FD Receipt from a commercial bank/ Banker’s cheque. Details for submission of EMD/PBG: Beneficiary for submission of EM : Manager(F&A), MAPS D/PBG by DD/FDR etc., Beneficiary for submission of EM : Nuclear Power Corporation of India D/PBG by Net Banking/RTGS/NEF T Bank Name : State Bank of India Account No. : 35160060466 IFSC Code : SBIN0002219 Branch address : DAE Township, Kalpakkam-603102 8. Bidders/suppliers/contractors can submit EMD/Performance Security/PBG et c., preferably through SBI Collect Facility. Steps to follow to avail this facility is detailed below: (a) Go to authenticate website of SBI online. (link – onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect) (b) Go to SB collect tab & click. (c) Go to PSU-Public Sector Undertaking tab & click (d) Type “Nuclear Power Corporation of India” in search bar. (e) Select “Tamilnadu” as State in filter option in State tab. (f) Select appropriate payment category “Earnest Money Deposit/Performance Bank Guara ntee” (g) Fill up the relevant details & follow the procedure of bank payment. Bidders may contact SBI Customer Service Helplines, if any, required to complete the trans action.
